```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Python environment check
# ---------------------------------------------------------

required_packages <- c(
  "numpy",
  "pandas",
  "seaborn",
  "matplotlib",
  "statsmodels"
)

envname <- "~/.virtualenvs/r-reticulate"

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!reticulate::py_module_available(pkg)) {

    message("Installing missing Python package: ", pkg)

    reticulate::py_install(
      packages = pkg,
      envname = envname,
      pip = TRUE
    )
  }
}


```
